rule: Search records carry only Master text (titles, summaries, governed fields) except the generic source-locator and dated-event record wording below, which is controlled interface copy. A dated event has no governed title of its own, so its record is named by that wording plus its governed period, and its summary is the governed fact. The chronology's analytical rule is not a dated event and is not indexed.
